Generate the SLURM Job Scripts of a Chunked Run of Step 7

Source: R/barcoding_chunks.R
generate_barcoding_job_scripts.Rd

Writes the scripts that run classify_barcoding_folds() as a SLURM job array, one chunk per task on one core, and merge_barcoding_chunks() once every task has finished without error. It follows the conventions of generate_ml_search_script() and generate_bootstrap_script(): cluster_* arguments, load_module, one log per array task, and the versions the job ran with printed at its start.

Usage

generate_barcoding_job_scripts(
  library_dir,
  folds_dir,
  classifier_dir,
  method = c("idtaxa", "nn"),
  n_chunks,
  job_dir = file.path(classifier_dir, "job"),
  seed = 1L,
  threshold = 60,
  schemes = c("species", "genus"),
  loci = NULL,
  max_folds = NULL,
  cluster_job_name = "cactus_idtaxa",
  cluster_partition = "main",
  cluster_mem = "4G",
  cluster_time = "04:00:00",
  cluster_queue = NULL,
  cluster_mail_user = Sys.getenv("MY_EMAIL", ""),
  load_module = NULL,
  r_lib = NULL,
  rscript_exec = "Rscript"
)

Arguments

library_dir, folds_dir

Character. As in classify_barcoding_folds(), on the cluster.

classifier_dir

Character. output_dir of the run, on the cluster.

method, seed, threshold, schemes, loci, max_folds

As in classify_barcoding_folds().

n_chunks

Integer. Number of chunks, one array task each.

job_dir

Character. Where the scripts are written. Defaults to job/ inside classifier_dir.

cluster_job_name

Character. SLURM job name; the merge job adds _merge. Defaults to "cactus_idtaxa".

cluster_partition

Character. SLURM partition. Defaults to "main".

cluster_mem

Character. Memory per task (--mem). Defaults to "4G".

cluster_time

Character. Time limit per task (-t). Defaults to "04:00:00".

cluster_queue

Character. Optional SLURM QoS (-q). Defaults to NULL.

cluster_mail_user

Character. Address for SLURM mail. Defaults to Sys.getenv("MY_EMAIL", ""); an empty value writes no mail line. The array mails on failure only; the merge mails at its end.

load_module

Character vector of environment modules to load, or NULL.

r_lib

Character. R library to put first (R_LIBS_USER), or NULL.

rscript_exec

Character. The Rscript command. Defaults to "Rscript".

Value

Invisibly, the paths of the five files.

Details

Five files are written in job_dir: run_chunk.R and run_merge.R, which hold the arguments of the run; job_array.sh, the array (--array=1-n_chunks, one core per task); job_merge.sh, the merge; and submit.sh, which submits the array and then the merge with --dependency=afterok:<array>. Submit with bash submit.sh from any directory.

The paths are written as given and must be those of the cluster: pass absolute paths, or paths relative to the directory the job is submitted from. Nothing about a particular cluster is written unless it is passed: with load_module = NULL no module is loaded, with cluster_queue = NULL no QoS is requested, and with r_lib = NULL the default R library is used.

See also

classify_barcoding_folds(), merge_barcoding_chunks().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
generate_barcoding_job_scripts(
  library_dir = "/home/user/PhyloCactus_Tutorial/11_barcoding/4_library",
  folds_dir = "/home/user/PhyloCactus_Tutorial/11_barcoding/5_folds",
  classifier_dir = "/home/user/PhyloCactus_Tutorial/11_barcoding/7_classifier",
  method = "idtaxa", n_chunks = 60,
  load_module = "R/4.4.0", r_lib = "~/R/phylocactus/4.4"
)
} # }
